    private function backfillDeterministicLegacyRows(): void
    {
        $legacyUsers = collect();

            if (! Schema::hasTable($table) || ! Schema::hasColumn($table, 'user_id')) continue;

    /** @return list<int> */
    private function companyCandidatesForUser(int $userId): array
    {
        $ids = [];
        $membership = trim((string) config('crm.tenancy.membership_table', ''));
        if ($membership !== '' && Schema::hasTable($membership)) {
            $u = (string) config('crm.tenancy.membership_user_column','user_id');
            $c = (string) config('crm.tenancy.membership_company_column','company_id');
            $ids = DB::table($membership)->where($u,$userId)->pluck($c)->filter(fn($v)=>is_numeric($v)&&(int)$v>0)->map(fn($v)=>(int)$v)->unique()->values()->all();
        }
        if ($ids === [] && Schema::hasTable((string)config('crm.tenancy.users_table','users'))) {
            $users = (string) config('crm.tenancy.users_table','users');
            foreach ((array) config('crm.tenancy.user_company_columns',['active_company_id','current_company_id','company_id']) as $column) {
                if (! Schema::hasColumn($users,(string)$column)) continue;
                $value = DB::table($users)->where('id',$userId)->value((string)$column);
                if (is_numeric($value) && (int)$value>0) $ids[]=(int)$value;
            }
        }
        $ids=array_values(array_unique($ids)); sort($ids); return $ids;
